svg.title: Allocate $30,000 Before Expanding the Pod
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate $30,000 Before Expanding the Pod; subtitle: Four capital buckets inside the $10,000–$45,000 startup range; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values represent a $30,000 central startup plan. Each detail supplies matching lean and expanded allocations: lean totals $10,000; expanded totals $45,000. Startup capital is not additional recognized revenue or an automatic annual expense. Reserve balances become expenses only when spent on qualifying operating costs.; caption: Central allocation is $8,000 + $7,000 + $5,000 + $10,000 = $30,000. Monthly operating needs span $1,500–$9,500; a $10,000 cash reserve covers only about 1.1–6.7 months before delivery labor and other excluded commitments. With first deals taking 4–12 months, stage spending and secure additional runway rather than anticipating awards.; stages: label: Lawful Evidence Access; value: $8,000 central allocation; 26.7% of capital; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Lean allocation is $2,000; expanded allocation is $12,000. Purchase necessary dataset rights, limited source retrieval, and targeted corroboration rather than broad subscriptions without paid demand.; label: Secure Research Environment; value: $7,000 central allocation; 23.3% of capital; numeric value: 7000.0; detail: Lean allocation is $2,000; expanded allocation is $10,000. Fund encrypted endpoints, matter-level permissions, backups, reproducible processing, and access logging before sensitive materials arrive.; label: Engagement and Quality Setup; value: $5,000 central allocation; 16.7% of capital; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Lean allocation is $2,000; expanded allocation is $8,000. Fund engagement documentation, initial insurance costs, external technical checks, and counsel-directed handling procedures for sensitive work.; label: Uncommitted Cash Reserve; value: $10,000 central allocation; 33.3% of capital; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Lean allocation is $4,000; expanded allocation is $15,000. Keep liquidity available for delayed collections and essential operating costs; do not treat sealed matters as cash collateral.
